name: Still-Water Monk
languages: Common plus one other language, Draconic

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: The still-water monk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Marsh Stride
abilities.description: Difficult terrain composed of mud doesn't cost the still-water monk extra movement, and the still-water monk can move across mud without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Patient Defense
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the still-water monk takes the Dodge action.

abilities.name: Cunning Action
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the still-water monk takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

abilities.name: Riposte (Reaction)
abilities.description: When a creature within 5 feet of the still-water monk misses it with a melee attack, the still-water monk makes one Unarmed Strike attack against that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The still-water monk makes two attacks: one with its Unarmed Strike and one with its Dart.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (6d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Once on each of the still-water monk's turns when it hits with this attack, the target is subjected to the following effect. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the still-water monk's next turn.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

other_edition.lore: Hatched in the blackwater shallows beneath a stilts-raised monastery, this wandering monk tests every worthy foe against its order's discipline: the still water that carves the canyon.
